title: Cooperation: Your Soul’s Intention
fullTitle: Soul Feast #10: Cooperation: Your Soul’s Intention
description: In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav dives into the soul’s intention of cooperation and how it differs fundamentally from mere collaboration rooted in fear or self-interest.

Continuing his exploration of the intentions of the soul – harmony, sharing, reverence for life, and cooperation – Gary provides insights into how aligning our actions with love creates not only cooperation, but also joy through co-creation.
Gary contrasts traditional collaboration, often driven by motives like personal gain or safety, with cooperation and co-creation, acts grounded in love and spiritual partnership .
If you’re ready to explore the difference between participating out of fear versus contributing with love and your Soul’s intentions, this soul feast is a must-listen.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take your soul journal and reflect on moments of cooperation in your daily life. Were your actions motivated by fear – seeking approval, safety, or personal gain? Or by love, fostering connection and contributing to the greater good? Use this reflection to guide you toward creating more meaningful co-creations.
